name: KPI tile
purpose: Show one headline number with unit, reference value and as-of time.
use_when: A few top-level counts or rates that answer the first question (D01).
avoid_when: More than about 6 tiles, or a number with no baseline or unit.
a11y: Text value with unit read by screen readers; delta not by color alone; tile is not the only place the value appears.
keywords: kpi tile card number count headline metric indicator total delta baseline

name: Alert list
purpose: Ranked list of events linked to map features, with severity, time and status.
use_when: Exceptions need triage: detections, gaps, outages, new fires.
avoid_when: Information is not actionable or alert volume is high without grouping.
a11y: Severity as icon plus text; list items are focusable buttons; announce new alerts politely not assertively.
keywords: alert list feed event events notifications exceptions severity triage incidents

name: Feature table
purpose: Sortable, filterable table of features with row-to-map linking.
use_when: Users compare many records: fields, vessels, reservoirs, detections.
avoid_when: Fewer than ~5 records, or geometry is the only thing that matters.
a11y: Real table semantics with sortable column headers; selected row marked beyond color; keyboard row navigation.
keywords: feature table grid rows sortable columns attributes records list sparkline ranking

name: Layer panel
purpose: Toggle, group and re-order layers with per-layer opacity.
use_when: More than two layers, or optional overlays.
avoid_when: Single-layer map or fixed story view.
a11y: Checkboxes with labels and group headings; grey-out out-of-scale layers with a reason; focus order matches visual order.
keywords: layer panel layers toggle visibility group opacity order checkbox legend list layer control

name: Legend
purpose: Explain symbols and ramps for what is currently drawn.
use_when: Always, for any thematic layer.
avoid_when: Never omit; for basic basemap-only views use a minimal one.
a11y: Swatches paired with text labels; legend reflects visible layers only; contrast of swatch borders at 3:1.
keywords: legend key swatch classes ramp symbology colorbar units classification

name: Time slider
purpose: Scrub, play and step a time range or single date, with presets.
use_when: Data has regular time steps and users compare states over time.
avoid_when: Series is better shown per point as a chart, or only two dates matter (use swipe).
a11y: Keyboard step with arrow keys and visible value; play/pause button; non-drag alternative; respects reduced motion.
keywords: time slider playback play pause scrub animation date range timeline step temporal

name: Swipe compare
purpose: Before/after comparison with a draggable divider and date labels on both halves.
use_when: Comparing two dates or two products over the same extent.
avoid_when: More than two dates (use side-by-side) or continuous change (use a chart).
a11y: Divider is a slider role operable by keyboard; both dates labelled; offer toggle as non-drag alternative.
keywords: before after swipe curtain slider compare dates imagery change comparison divider

name: Availability date picker
purpose: Calendar that marks dates with actual acquisitions and their cloud cover.
use_when: Satellite or periodic data with irregular availability.
avoid_when: Daily complete data, where a plain date input is enough.
a11y: Calendar grid with keyboard navigation; available dates distinguishable by more than color; cloud % as text.
keywords: date picker calendar availability acquisition dates scene cloud cover satellite imagery pass

name: Scene card
purpose: Compact card for a satellite scene: date, sensor, cloud %, footprint thumbnail.
use_when: Browsing or choosing imagery.
avoid_when: Imagery is not a user decision, only a backdrop.
a11y: Card is a labelled button; thumbnail has alt text; cloud percentage shown as text.
keywords: scene card thumbnail footprint satellite sensor acquisition cloud percent metadata imagery item

name: AOI draw and measure
purpose: Draw, upload and edit an area of interest; measure distance and area.
use_when: Users define analysis extents, geofences or subscriptions.
avoid_when: Read-only public viewer.
a11y: Provide coordinate entry as a drawing alternative; tool state announced; finish with Enter or Esc.
keywords: aoi draw polygon measure area distance geofence upload shapefile extent select region

name: Confidence slider
purpose: Filter detections or alerts by minimum confidence, with live counts.
use_when: ML or rule-based detections with a score.
avoid_when: Binary data with no score.
a11y: Labelled slider with numeric readout and arrow-key steps; count announced after change.
keywords: confidence slider threshold filter score detection probability minimum model false positives

name: Review queue
purpose: Work through detections one by one: confirm, reject, comment.
use_when: Human validation or false-positive feedback is part of the workflow.
avoid_when: Fully automated, no human loop.
a11y: Keyboard shortcuts for confirm/reject listed in UI; progress text; undo.
keywords: review queue validate confirm reject verify triage false positive feedback labeling task inbox

name: Time-series chart
purpose: Line or bar series for a selected feature or region, with trend, band or climatology.
use_when: A value changes over time and users need trend, seasonality or acceleration.
avoid_when: A single snapshot or categorical comparison.
a11y: Data table alternative; series labelled directly; cloudy observations flagged; line style not color alone.
keywords: time series chart line trend over time sparkline displacement ndvi count history climatology band epi curve

name: Histogram with class breaks
purpose: Distribution of an indicator with class breaks overlaid, linked to the map classification.
use_when: Choropleth or ramp classification needs checking.
avoid_when: Categorical data.
a11y: Break values as text; chart has a text summary; selection by keyboard.
keywords: histogram class breaks classification distribution quantile jenks natural breaks bins choropleth velocity rate

name: Transition Sankey
purpose: From-to flows between classes (land cover transitions) with areas.
use_when: Categorical change between two dates.
avoid_when: More than ~10 classes without grouping, or only net change matters (use diverging bar).
a11y: Provide transition matrix table alternative; flows labelled with area.
keywords: sankey transition matrix flow from to land cover change class conversion gain loss

name: Detail drawer
purpose: Side or bottom panel with a feature's curated attributes, chart and actions.
use_when: Click a feature to see more than a popup can hold.
avoid_when: Few attributes (use a popup).
a11y: Focus moves into drawer on open and returns to the feature on close; Esc closes; landmark role.
keywords: detail drawer side panel feature details attributes popup profile card inspector click

name: Filter chips
purpose: Visible, removable chips for active filters and quick categorical toggles.
use_when: Multiple filters apply and users must see what is filtered.
avoid_when: Single static filter.
a11y: Toggle buttons with pressed state; chip removal by keyboard; results count announced.
keywords: filter chips tags active filters type class status category toggle facets

name: Basemap switcher
purpose: Choose among a few basemaps (muted, imagery, dark).
use_when: Imagery verification or dark/light themes are needed.
avoid_when: Single-basemap story or when basemap is part of the symbology.
a11y: Radio group with labels, not thumbnails alone; attribution updates with basemap.
keywords: basemap switcher background satellite imagery dark light theme base layer toggle

name: Geocoder
purpose: Search for a place, address or coordinate and fly there.
use_when: Users start from place or address.
avoid_when: Fixed AOI dashboard.
a11y: Combobox pattern; results list navigable by keyboard; no-results message.
keywords: geocoder search address place coordinates locate find zoom lookup mmsi

name: Coordinate readout
purpose: Show cursor or selected coordinates, CRS and scale; allow copy.
use_when: Technical or field users need exact positions.
avoid_when: Public-facing simple maps.
a11y: Also available as text on demand; not only on hover; copy button.
keywords: coordinate readout lat lon latitude longitude cursor position crs scale mgrs copy

name: Freshness and status bar
purpose: Per-source "as of" time, latency and health.
use_when: Any live or periodically updated data.
avoid_when: Static archival maps (still show the vintage).
a11y: Status by text and icon, not color alone; stale state announced.
keywords: freshness status bar last updated as of latency data age health stale refresh timestamp source

name: Export and report
purpose: Export data, image or a report of current view and filters.
use_when: Evidence, patrol, briefing or downstream tools are the goal.
avoid_when: Exploration-only views.
a11y: Buttons with explicit format labels; progress and result announced; includes metadata and date.
keywords: export report download csv geojson pdf image evidence sitrep print share briefing
